description: Talend Cloud (TMC) Tasks + Plans as Dagster assets. Discovers /orchestration/executables/{tasks,plans} + optionally triggers an execution + polls to completion, honoring Dagster's own asset selection. Fivetran-shape workspace: block for auth + selector for filtering + polling_sensor + freshness_lag_threshold_seconds.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per selected item discovered in the vendor. See README for what each materialization produces.

artifact_selector.label: Artifact Selector
artifact_selector.description: Filter which Talend artifacts become Dagster assets. Omit for all.

action.label: Action
action.description: noop = external asset; execute = trigger a Talend execution + poll.

execution_parameters.label: Execution Parameters
execution_parameters.description: Optional runtime/context parameters sent on every Task execution (POST body `parameters` field). Per-artifact overrides via `translation:`.

log_level.label: Log Level
log_level.description: Optional Talend execution log level override.

emit_quality_checks.label: Emit Quality Checks
emit_quality_checks.description: Emit a talend_execution_quality asset check per artifact from each execution's own processed/rejected row counts.

fail_on_rejected_rows.label: Fail On Rejected Rows
fail_on_rejected_rows.description: Raise a hard Dagster Failure (instead of only failing the quality check) when a Talend execution completes with rejected rows over its own configured threshold.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.

name: Talend Cloud Workspace
